name: musubi
description: Musubi monorepo — open, self-hostable shared calendar.

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @musubi/client exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm exec tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit --skipLibCheck && pnpm --filter @musubi/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @musubi/calendar test && pnpm --filter @musubi/client exec tsx lib/eventForm.test.ts && pnpm --filter @musubi/client exec tsx lib/rrule.test.ts && pnpm --filter @musubi/client exec tsx lib/ics.test.ts && pnpm --filter @musubi/api test && pnpm --filter @musubi/db test && pnpm --filter @musubi/web test
scripts.check: pnpm release:verify && pnpm peers:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm lint && pnpm build
